seamModel.description: The synthetic `__omnimuxWorkbench` stub implements the official `ensureConversationVisible()` entry with NO arguments (hub no-arg semantics: exit a host right-sidebar fullscreen + clear the collapse key + keep split, so the library stage and its toast stay visible), records the full argument list, and sets body[data-conversation]=open. It keeps the replicate-style `setConversationCollapsed`/`setFocus` recorders for the fallback. The real hub ensure/fullscreen-exit logic is covered by hub unit tests, not by this fixture.

assertions.name: click reveals the conversation before the member read finishes (ensure called immediately with no arguments)
ensureConversationVisible is called exactly 3 times with NO arguments and replaces the collapse/focus fallback
conversation column is open after the click and the collection prompt is appended after a blank line
no blocking toast, no send, no send-like request
fallback: without ensure, the replicate-style collapse/focus pair reveals the column and the append still happens
no browser request escaped the fixture origin; no console exceptions

boundaries: Synthetic workbench/append seams and the conversation column/composer; this is not a full Host install. The real ensureConversationVisible (exit host right-sidebar fullscreen + clear collapse key) is covered by hub unit tests and is not re-implemented here.

Real: product InspirationSection bundle, production local handlers/store, real loopback HTTP, real DOM/composer writes and clicks in headless Chrome; the deferred member read proves reveal ordering in-page.
No Dev app (port 45120), no user profile, no external network; dynamic loopback ports only; Chrome/server/temp store cleaned up.
